connector.name: MCP by clipy.online
connector.registryDescription: Read your Clipy screen recordings: search, transcripts, AI summaries, and key moments with frames.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace online.clipy, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLIPY_API_KEY
env.description: Clipy API key. Optional — the server reads the credential `clipy login` stores at ~/.config/clipy/config.json. Set this to override it, or for CI where there is no login. Create a key free at https://clipy.online/settings/api-keys

env.name: CLIPY_API_URL
env.description: Override the Clipy API base URL (defaults to https://clipy.online)
